scope: Legacy registered OperatorController classes; a public oracle proves only its named pipeline shape, not every option or ordering.

routes.native_graph: DAG-ML owns graph, fold, selection or merge semantics; Python binds nirs4all operators.
routes.host_operator: DAG-ML schedules a Python model or transform controller callback.
routes.host_preparation: Python reshapes or annotates dataset inputs before native execution.
routes.host_presentation: Python renders a chart from captured DAG-ML results.
routes.gap: A public legacy capability is refused or has no matching DAG-ML path.
routes.fallback: Catch-all router with no independent pipeline capability.
